findings.issue: `phase_completion.commit_records` 只校验 `phase_id` 和 40-hex 形状，未校验记录的 commit 是否等于 `worktree_root` 当前 HEAD，也未校验该 commit 是否包含至少一个非 tracking 的 implementation/test 文件。这样仍可接受“post-review tracking-only HEAD，真实实现 commit 在 HEAD^”的旧问题；下游 verify-code 会消费不稳定事实。
findings.recommendation: 在 build-code stage-result 校验中使用 `facts.worktree_root` 读取 `git rev-parse HEAD`，要求 file-changing phase 的 `commit_sha` 等于当前 HEAD，并检查该 commit 的 changed files 至少包含非 task/review/evidence/stage-result 等 tracking 路径的 implementation/test 文件；否则返回错误。对应补负测：HEAD 为 tracking-only、commit_records 指向 HEAD^ 时必须 fail。

findings.issue: 文档写了“recorded implementation commit must match final HEAD and must contain at least one non-tracking implementation/test file”，但当前可执行契约没有实现该检查。只靠 SKILL.md 文字约束，不能关闭 prior finding“无 post-review tracking-only HEAD^ acceptance”。
findings.recommendation: 把该文字约束落到可执行 gate/validator 中，并在 tests 中覆盖：合法 implementation HEAD pass；tracking-only HEAD + commit_records 指向旧实现 commit fail；commit_records 指向不存在 commit fail。

resolutionSummary: revise_required：stage-result facts.phase_completion 已新增，review raw JSON artifact 也已收敛；但 prior blocking 的核心仍未闭合。当前实现只校验 commit_sha 形状，不校验 HEAD ownership 和非 tracking 内容，仍能接受 post-review tracking-only HEAD^。

findings.description: Spec describes a schema/contract/gate (cluster A) with soft-fail, optional, or warning-only validation — or a check that bypasses its own control switch (cluster B: soft-fail/swallow/bypass-flag terms). A gate that does not hard-block on failure allows output drift — schema-drift blocking.

Spec describes or requires eliminating internal contradictions between field contracts or rule statements (cluster A: schema/contract terms + cluster B: conflict/contradiction/duplicate terms). Multiple conflicting schemas for the same entity cause silent drift — schema-drift blocking.
